description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer virtual-bottom checkpoint: safe Rust owns cursor/viewport/virtual-bottom state transitions outside text reflow.

entries.notes: Safe Rust grows virtual bottom when output advances the cursor below it while preserving a manually scrolled viewport until explicitly returning to the virtual viewport.
API cursor positioning restores the virtual viewport for in-range positions and rebases virtual bottom only when moving above or below the virtual range.
Internal viewport-height changes preserve virtual bottom unless the resize crosses through it, at which point viewport bottom and virtual bottom realign.
An offscreen line feed that remains above virtual bottom advances the cursor without perturbing virtual-bottom state.
Window-resize VT changes viewport dimensions without implicitly rebasing an existing virtual bottom.
Making the cursor visible scrolls the viewport only as far as needed and preserves virtual bottom both above and below the cursor.
Returning to the virtual viewport restores its vertical origin without losing the existing horizontal viewport offset.
